Lumber prices

What a 2x4, 2x6 or 4x4 costs per board at US home centers, in the lengths you can buy, with the actual size of each nominal dimension. These are the prices the calculators on this site work with.

Prices as of November 2026. They are typical home center prices, not quotes. Lumber prices change weekly, differ by region and are often lower at a lumberyard for larger orders. Boards of 16 ft and longer cost more per foot than shorter ones.

Nominal and actual size

Lumber is named by its rough-sawn size before drying and planing. A 2x4 is actually 1-1/2 × 3-1/2 in., a 2x6 1-1/2 × 5-1/2 in. From 2x8 upward the width is 3/4 in. less than the name, so a 2x10 is 9-1/4 in. wide. Boards named 1x are 3/4 in. thick, 5/4 decking is 1 in. thick. The tables above show the actual size for each.

Price per board foot

Lumberyards often price by the board foot: one board foot is 1 × 12 × 12 in. of nominal size. A 2x4 has 2/3 board foot per foot of length, a 2x12 has 2 board feet per foot. To compare a board foot price with the tables, multiply it by those numbers.

Which grade and treatment?

  • Above ground treated lumber (UC3B) is for decking, rails and joists that dry out quickly.
  • Ground contact treated lumber (UC4A) is for posts, anything within 6 in. of the soil and for joists and beams that are hard to replace. Many builders now use it for all deck framing.
  • No. 2 is the standard structural grade the span tables are based on. No. 1 and Prime have fewer knots and cost more.

How to save on lumber

  • Plan cuts so the offcuts get used. The shopping lists in the calculators do that automatically.
  • 8 ft studs are often priced below the per-foot rate of longer 2x4s.
  • Compare a lumberyard quote for whole bundles with the home center price for single boards.
  • Pick straight boards yourself and check the crown before you buy.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a 2x4 right now?
An 8 ft 2x4 stud costs about $4 to $5 at home centers in late 2026, whitewood slightly less than pressure-treated. Longer 2x4s cost more per foot: a 16 ft treated 2x4 is around $14.
How much is a pressure-treated 2x6x12?
About $14 to $16 at home centers, depending on grade and region.
Why is a 2x4 not 2 by 4 inches?
The name is the size of the rough board after sawing. Drying and planing take off about 1/2 in., so the finished board measures 1-1/2 × 3-1/2 in.

Lumber sizes follow the span tables of the 2021 International Residential Code (IRC) and are planning values. They do not replace a permit review or an engineer. Decks, patio covers and carports usually need a building permit, so check with your local building department.
